title: Desk market wrap 11/9
summary: Stocks bounced to start the week as oil dropped another 3% and eased inflation fears, though AI financing stayed an overhang. SPY and QQQ squeezed back to the 8-day average on a wide-range session; desk waits on this week's inflation data. A few large call books adjusted.

title: Desk open wrap 11/9
summary: Futures firmer to start the week as oil kept falling and metals bid; VIX dropped again. Europe recovered some of last week's losses and Nikkei bounced after last week's slide. CPI is next.
